items.title: Virtual Punya Snan Service
items.text: Arrange Punya Snan in your name at sacred destinations like Ganga.
items.imageAlt: Holy water poured from cupped hands at the river ghat at sunrise
items.bannerImageAlt: Temples and boats on the river ghats at sunrise
items.aboutTitle: A sacred dip, offered in your name
items.aboutText1: Punya Snan is the holy bath taken in a sacred river on an auspicious day. It is believed to cleanse the mind, remove past sins and bring the blessings of the river goddess to the devotee and their family.
items.aboutText2: Many devotees cannot travel to Haridwar, Prayagraj or Varanasi because of distance, health or work. With Virtual Punya Snan, our priests take the sacred dip on your behalf with your name, gotra and photograph, following the full Vedic process.
items.aboutImageAlt: A hand offering flowers on a leaf as holy water falls into the river at sunrise
items.shloka:
गङ्गे च यमुने चैव गोदावरि सरस्वति।
नर्मदे सिन्धु कावेरि जलेऽस्मिन् सन्निधिं कुरु॥

faqs.q: What is a Virtual Punya Snan Service?
faqs.a: A Virtual Punya Snan Service allows devotees to participate remotely in arrangements associated with the sacred bathing tradition when they cannot visit the holy place in person.

faqs.q: Can I book this service if I cannot travel to the holy place?
faqs.a: Yes. This service is intended for devotees who cannot travel because of distance, work, family responsibilities, health concerns, or other personal reasons.

faqs.q: What details are required for the booking?
faqs.a: You may be asked to provide your name, gotra, wish, and photograph for the ritual arrangements. Please follow the booking instructions provided by the service team.

faqs.q: Will I receive a video of the ritual?
faqs.a: Yes. As part of the described service, you receive a recorded video of the ritual so that you can watch it with your family.

faqs.q: Can devotees living outside India use this service?
faqs.a: Devotees living outside India can enquire about availability and booking arrangements. Please confirm the applicable process and payment options before booking.

items.title: Virtual Festival Darshan Service
items.text: Experience famous festivals and melas through live video calls.
items.imageAlt: Temples and ghats lit up at sunset during a festival

items.aboutText1: Festivals hold a special place in Hindu traditions. During these occasions, devotees visit temples, attend religious celebrations, and seek blessings from their deities. Festival darshan gives people an opportunity to feel connected to their faith and take part in important religious traditions.
items.aboutText2: However, not everyone can visit a temple during a festival. Distance, work, family responsibilities, health concerns, and large crowds can make travel difficult. Our Virtual Festival Darshan Service is designed for devotees who wish to stay connected to festival celebrations even when they cannot attend in person. It offers a convenient way to experience live darshan remotely and remain connected to the traditions that matter to them.

items.aboutText1: Puja is an important part of Hindu religious traditions. Devotees perform puja to express their devotion, offer prayers, and seek the blessings of their chosen deities. From daily worship to special occasions, puja helps families stay connected to their faith and religious customs.
items.aboutText2: However, arranging a puja is not always easy when you are busy with work, living away from home, or unable to visit a temple or arrange the rituals in person. Our Virtual Puja Booking Service helps devotees explore and book available puja arrangements remotely. You can select the puja according to your needs, share the required details, and receive confirmation about the arrangements without having to manage every step yourself.

items.aboutText1: Pind Daan and Shraddh are important Hindu religious rituals performed in remembrance of departed family members and ancestors. These traditions hold a special place in Hindu beliefs and are observed by families to express respect, gratitude, and devotion towards their ancestors. Many families perform these rituals according to their customs and religious traditions.
items.aboutText2: However, arranging Pind Daan or Shraddh rituals can be difficult when family members live far away, have work commitments, or cannot travel to the required location. Our Pind Daan & Shraddh Service helps devotees explore and arrange available ritual services remotely. Families often seek a knowledgeable pandit for religious occasions, festivals, ceremonies, and important moments in their lives. Having the right guidance can help them understand the rituals and prepare for the occasion.
items.aboutText2: However, finding a suitable pandit and coordinating the arrangements can sometimes be difficult, especially when you have a busy schedule or live away from your family location. Our Pandit Booking Service helps you explore available booking options according to your religious needs and occasion. You can share your requirements, check the available arrangements, and confirm your booking through a simple process.
